summary: Re-arm exact native continuation when an authored session selector is removed.

replay.detail: Existing diagnostic claims are read directly; legacy authored refusals become stale when no authored selector remains.

schema.detail: Adds optional session_id and selector_scope fields to the harness.diagnostic claim schema. No database migration or index change.

rules.detail: Diagnostic admission now permits the two optional continuation fields. Existing claims remain valid; actor authority is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Authored-selector refusals are scoped to the selector; intrinsic and provider refusals remain permanent and use a distinct typed operation identity.

manual.detail: Remove the authored selector to allow exact continuation of the recorded binding. Fresh-context and account precedence remain unchanged.

recovery.detail: A later permanent failure cannot collide with a stale legacy refusal. Roll forward: older claim validators do not admit diagnostics carrying the new optional fields.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon upgrade restart; interruption duration has not been measured.
